'''yodaindahouze The Fleet Sets Course for Alderaan''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[yodaindahouze]]
* '''Published:''' 12 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat SYCFA yodaindahouze DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

this deck has been a lot of fun to play because you can retrieve force at the same time blowing stuff up.

== Strategy ==

the idea is obvious as for all SYCFA decks. get the gunners to the death star and get the superlaser down. remember to draw the CPI and Executor to start the game so the destinies are out of the deck.  try and keep your star destroyers so that you can play them to retrieve force after alderaan is blown.  if you need to face down an MBO deck then put down zuckuss and a DSAS. after blowing alderaan you can get the other systems out to start force draining huge amounts with FWKTIL(V).  i know this deck lacks a sidious or maul; that's something i'm working on. otherwise this deck does pretty good on the ground. please rate, have a nice day, and may the force be with you.
